candidate_relations.reason: Although both can present as multiple vascular cutaneous lesions in infancy, the lesions were present at birth and histology showed lobulated capillary proliferation with GLUT-1 negativity, supporting congenital disseminated pyogenic granuloma rather than multifocal infantile hemangioma, which is typically GLUT-1 positive.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different multifocal benign vascular tumor subtype from congenital disseminated pyogenic granuloma.
